audit_stage: fourth batch; causal learned streaming opt-in; prior measured evidence retained

items.expected: SE₂(3), Lie tools, numerical Jacobians
items.reality: SO(3) Exp/Log/Jacobians and SE₂(3) injection; no standalone full SE₂(3) API.

items.expected: InEKF and ESKF shared mechanization
items.reality: Both 15-state filters runnable; Joseph updates and navigation covariance conversion tested. Large 90-degree convergence acceptance and KF-GINS cross-validation absent.

items.expected: 18-state online δm mounting estimation
items.reality: 15-state only; i2Nav opposite-half offline mounting fixed during evaluation.

items.expected: GM biases, second-order discretization, IMU YAML profiles
items.reality: Random-walk biases, first-order Phi; dataclass noise and optional Earth correction.

items.expected: LC position/optional velocity and lever arm
items.reality: Position LC with lever arm supported/tested; optional GNSS velocity absent.

items.expected: Gate and robust Huber/Student-t GNSS
items.reality: Huber plus chi-square gate wired via Config/CLI; forced reacquisition after repeated rejects; default robust off.

items.expected: 3-layer dilated TCN, roll/pitch, bias-compensated IMU, β-NLL heads
items.reality: Baseline: plain six-channel stride CNN, no attitude/dilation. Pullback: MotionNetTCN 1/2/4 dilations, eight normalized IMU+roll/pitch channels, beta-NLL, live filter attitude/current-bias correction in batch; explicit sim-training and CLI architecture selection; legacy_cnn training default. Legacy weights still load. Original simulation training budget **resolved**: both arches trained on 100–119 × 600 s, same 12 epochs and smooth variance; full-protocol val/test evidence in the new report. Independent real-drive validation and M3 acceptance remain missing.

items.expected: Sliding windows and real body-velocity supervision
items.reality: Simulation/KITTI/i2Nav windows and labels; KITTI body velocity corrected using R-transformed ENU rather than horizontal vf/vl.

items.expected: Fixed NHC, learned NHC and learned full velocity
items.reality: All batch modes selectable; hybrid/v2/v3 add forward rejection and fixed lateral/vertical NHC.

items.expected: Per-learning-channel online κ and outage inflation
items.reality: learned_vel calibrates three channels; hybrid/v2/v3 only forward; pre-pseudo reference is GNSS-constrained prior, t>30 and recent accepted GNSS. Clipped alpha/sliding window/bounded κ; correlated closed-loop reference.

items.expected: Online GNSS κ_g from vector NIS
items.reality: Opt-in joint vector-NIS κ_g, pre-update C+κ_g R, next-fix scale, healthy accepted unforced references; tested batch path/calibration pilot. Integrity threshold/attack acceptance remains open; AdaptiveR is a separate Sage-Husa path.

items.expected: Nominal long-run coverage and consistent closed loop
items.reality: Published v3 full/outage simulation 0.699/0.833; shift 0.730/0.876; KITTI FT outage 0.681; i2Nav mounted v3 0.574, correlation-NHC 0.887. ACI is NOT a mathematical closed-loop integrity guarantee.

items.expected: GNSS-free DR guard, CUSUM, healthy-window reset
items.reality: Batch dual guard and single-channel comparison present; reset uses current health rather than proving entire-window health; alarms latch without recovery M epochs.

items.expected: HPL and HPE>HPL reporting
items.reality: No HPL output or exceedance metric; NEES coverage is different.

items.expected: Sensor→learning→ACI→integrity online assembly
items.reality: Baseline fixed NHC/ZUPT/wheel parity retained. Opt-in LearnedStreamingNavigator: causal learned_vel/learned_nhc, ACI, GNSS κ_g, DR-CUSUM, bounded delayed on-grid GNSS; no hybrid/wheel combination, replay, HPL/recovery.

items.expected: Configuration end-to-end assembly and reports
items.reality: Simulation CLI supports learned checkpoint, ACI, dual monitor and robust GNSS via Config; scripts handle real datasets.

items.expected: Two MEMS grades; outages, jumps, colored noise, ramp attacks
items.reality: Simulation noise/bias/vibration, colored GNSS and configurable outages/ramp; no comprehensive two-grade jump/NLOS benchmark.

items.expected: Disjoint drives; real IMU plus synthetic GNSS
items.reality: Drive splits and test segments implemented; GNSS truth+noise/outage/spoof, NOT real received GNSS.

items.expected: Real MEMS/RTK cross-device, KF-GINS validation
items.reality: Real RTK, four co-mounted IMUs, opposite time halves of ONE drive; no independent roads or KF-GINS comparison.

items.expected: B0–B5/Ours, A1–A4
items.reality: B0–B4 variants and ACI/inflation/filter/single-monitor ablations recorded. B5 VB/Student-t not present; Sage-Husa/Huber are different. No unified full Ours benchmark with GNSS κ_g/HPL.

items.expected: Locked splits, paired baselines, ≥20 MC, mean/std
items.reality: Simulation 100–119 train,500–503 val,900–909 test,700–705 calibration. Only 10 test seeds; KITTI held-out drives; i2Nav same-drive temporal folds. Original 20×600 s training restored for both arches in the full protocol; ten paired test seeds, not ≥20-test-run acceptance.

items.expected: RMSE, velocity/yaw, %DT, NEES/NIS fit, HPL, FAs/hour, efficiency
items.reality: Position RMSE/outage endpoints/NEES/coverage/runtime; spoof delays and detection counts. Missing unified yaw/%DT/NIS-fit/HPL/memory/FA-per-hour suite.

items.expected: Automatic full report and plots
items.reality: Separate experiment scripts and tables; no unified make_report.py full M6 acceptance.

items.expected: TorchScript/ONNX export
items.reality: State-dict persistence only; no export utility.

items.expected: UrbanNav raw mult satellite pseudorange TC + clock/NLOS
items.reality: Single RTK baseline projected to rank-one scalar range replaces vector update; exploratory substitute, no satellites/clock/RINEX/UrbanNav.

items.expected: Fixed-lag RTS 1–5s
items.reality: No smoother.

items.expected: Healthy GNSS last-layer SGD with rollback
items.reality: Offline fine-tuning only.

items.expected: Optional wheel scale; later causal motion research
items.reality: Mounted wheel/ZUPT integrated and parity tested; no wheel-scale state or real wheel data; synthetic wheel studies are exploratory.
